name: Thick Pelt arms from damage taken, not from the Bloodmage's own swings (#2325)
contract: Thick Pelt 704626 reads 'Physical damage taken now reduces the Physical damage taken from the next attack within $556233d by ${($556233m1+$AP*0.2)}'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Thick Pelt 556233 (MOD_DAMAGE_TAKEN, MiscValue 1 = physical, BasePoints -16 -> -15, ProcCharges 1, TargetA 1). Unlike the rest of this batch, Spell.dbc does give 704626 a proc flag - and it is the wrong one: ProcFlags 0x4 is PROC_FLAG_DONE_MELEE_AUTO_ATTACK, so the generated entry arms the buff on the Bloodmage's own outgoing swings. 556233 itself carries ProcFlags 0x2a8, the TAKEN melee/ranged set that matches the tooltip. The scenario needs both a neutral faction-7 punching bag that never strikes back and a hostile faction-14 creature that does. NOTE: this scenario covers only the proc condition. The tooltip's $AP*0.2 term is not delivered by anything (556233 has BasePoints -16 with EffectRealPointsPerLevel 0, no spell_bonus_data row, and its own text states $AP*0.25), so the issue is not fully settled and the amount is not asserted here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Thick Pelt passive is active
Swing at the neutral bag long enough for several auto attacks to land
DISCRIMINATING: the Bloodmage's own swings do not arm Thick Pelt 556233
SETUP: the hostile creature is engaged
Physical damage taken arms Thick Pelt 556233
